subject: MedLytics pilot: deployment mode options, kickoff timing & POA
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@medlytics.io>, Tom Chen <tom.chen@medlytics.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: MedLytics pilot: deployment mode options, kickoff timing & POA

Thanks again for taking time today — good conversation and helpful context. Quick recap from our discovery and clear asks so we can get a PoC scoped and scheduled: 

Call highlights
- Primary objective: validate an automated clinical note summarization flow for 3 pilot clinics (~25 users total).
- Data sensitivity: PHI present in transcripts; MedLytics must remain HIPAA-compliant.
- Latency target: median generation < 400ms for short notes; throughput 30 req/min during clinic windows.
- Budget: conservative — prefer to start with a minimal-cost trial and expand if ROI looks good.

Deployment modes discussed (high level)
- Hosted API: fastest to start, minimal ops; good for early UX validation but requires covered BAA and limited PHI handling (we can enable covered-hosted workflows).
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pool with stronger isolation and predictable throughput; good middle ground for cost vs control.
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation, ideal for strict compliance but longer setup and procurement.

Asks / proposed next steps
1) Alyssa / Tom: confirm which deployment constraints are deal-breakers vs preferences (e.g., must be VPC/on-prem vs okay to pilot hosted under BAA).
2) MedLytics: share security questionnaire and list of stakeholders who must sign off (CISO, infra lead, clinical data owner).
3) Redwood (Marissa / Ben): produce a short PoC plan with success criteria, minimal infra sizing for dedicated vs hosted fallbacks, and a 6-week timeline option so we can pick dates.

Proposed PoC skeleton (we can refine):
- Week 0: legal & security intake (BAA, HIPAA questionnaire)
- Week 1–2: technical kickoff (connectivity, sample dataset, test harness)
- Week 3–4: run pilot workload, capture latency/cost/quality metrics
- Week 5: evaluation and decision (hosted trial extension vs dedicated or private onboarding)

I’ve attached the MedLytics MVP we discussed and a placeholder cost sheet — Marissa/Ben, feel free to update. Alyssa, if that timeline looks roughly right I’ll follow up with a proposed kickoff slot next week.

Attachments: MedLytics_MVP_requirements.pdf, redwood-poc-cost-estimate.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.inference

Subject: Re: MedLytics pilot: deployment mode options, kickoff timing & POA

Thanks Karthik — great summary, much appreciated. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Security posture: HIPAA compliance is a hard requirement. Our CISO strongly prefers a VPC-first approach. That said, we are open to an initial hosted pilot IF: 1) there is an explicit BAA in place; 2) logs and data retention can be restricted and routed per our policy; and 3) we have a clear path to move to VPC or Dedicated after validation.
- Stakeholders to involve: 
  - Priya Nambiar (CISO) — priya.n@medlytics.io
  - Jason Park (Infra lead) — jason.park@medlytics.io
  - Dr. Elena Morris (Clinical owner) — elena.m@medlytics.io

Timeline: end of Q1 2027 is our target for a validated PoC and recommendation to the board. Budget: moderate — we need a starter estimate for a 6-week pilot that includes either a small Dedicated pool or a hosted trial with strict retention rules.

I’m attaching our HIPAA questionnaire and a short prioritization doc. For the hosted option, please be explicit about what data would persist and for how long.

Attachments: MedLytics_HIPAA_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Product Partnerships | MedLytics
alyssa@medlytics.io

Forwarding Alyssa’s reply — HIPAA questionnaire attached. Notes / internal asks: 

1) Security: Priya (CISO) will likely push for Private VPC. We should prepare a three-path PoC: Hosted (short, restricted retention + BAA), Dedicated reserved pool (small capacity), Private VPC (longer lead, network setup).
2) Sizing/est.: their pilot scope = 25 concurrent clinic users, expected 30 req/min burst. Suggest we produce two rough cost/size options: 
   - Minimal Dedicated: 1x A10G (or equivalent) with 4 model workers; expected median latency ~300–450ms depending on model; estimated monthly committed $X (fill in).
   - Hosted with strict retention: initial 30 days log retention, field-level redaction, lower commit cost.
3) PoC success criteria (draft):
   - Functional: summarization accuracy >= 85% MRR on clinician-facing rubric (we need Marissa’s eval prompt set).
   - Performance: median latency < 400ms; 95th < 1s under typical clinic load.
   - Ops: ability to rotate keys and export audit logs; no PHI left in backups after retention window.
   - Cost: per-visit inference cost below $0.20 (TBD).

Please add/adjust. Ben — can you sketch a short technical kickoff agenda and confirm availability for a session on Mon 22 Nov? I’ll hold a tentative slot and propose to MedLytics next week. Also attach the rough cost estimate and mark any items that need legal/SE input.

[Karthik attached: MedLytics_MVP_requirements.pdf, redwood-poc-cost-estimate.xlsx] 

Thanks,
Karthik
